0.original: Thubyrgeim requires your help to put her theories to the proof.

1.original: Having heard of your research on the subject of scholars, and your newfound ability to summon a faerie familiar, Thubyrgeim hopes you might humor her with testing a theory. To that end she invites you downstairs to the guild's practice area.

2.original: Following Thubyrgeim's instructions, after a brief moment of concentration, you call forth your faerie familiar, but she has taken the form of a Topaz Carbuncle. Satisfied to see her theory proven, Thubyrgeim invites you back upstairs.

3.original: Thubyrgeim thanks you for the demonstration, encouraging you to make use of what you have learned.

48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, how fortuitous. Might you spare a moment?

49.original: I recently received word that you've been researching the scholars of Nym at the behest of a Marauders' Guild member, is that right?

50.original: I see... And as a result, you can now call upon a faerie to aid you. Fascinating!

51.original: Might I trouble you to meet me downstairs in the practice area? There's something I very much wish for you to try.

52.original: Please wait for me downstairs. I will be along shortly.

54.original: My apologies for the wait. As for what I wish for you to attempt, it is a technique similar to what you've already employed with your egi.

55.original: Now, would you be so kind as to call forth your faerie?

56.original: How charming! The tales do little to capture its beauty.

57.original: This faerie is no doubt manifested in the image of that which you most closely associate with faeries, but my research suggests this form is not immutable.

58.original: Indeed, though a fundamental form may have been incorporated into the original incantation, with sufficient concentration, I believe it possible to supplant this form with the image of another entity. Try conjuring the faerie once more─this time, with a Carbuncle in your mind's eye.

59.original: Remarkable! And with only a single attempt!

60.original: 'Twould seem my theory holds, meaning this transformation should be merely superficial, and has done naught to affect its capacity for healing. Very good.

61.original: With that, we may conclude this little experiment. If you would follow me upstairs?

62.original: Thank you again for your help, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. That proved to be quite the spectacle.

63.original: I should hope you make use of what we've learned here today. I daresay your faerie's appearance may be without limit.

64.original: Your faerie's appearance can now be altered by using <hex:024804F2022203><hex:022810FF0C54657874436F6D6D616E64220903><hex:0248020103>.

65.original: For example, if you wish to change the appearance of Eos to appear as Ruby Carbuncle, use the text command <hex:024804F2022203>/petglamour “eos” “ruby carbuncle”<hex:0248020103>.
